claims.statement: NVIDIA states that Spectrum-6 switch systems, described as supporting both pluggable and co-packaged optics as part of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, are arriving across gigascale AI factories. This is issuer-side confirmation that CPO has reached shipping deployment in NVIDIA's switch line. It is simultaneously counter-evidence to any thesis that CPO is the sole viable interconnect for this generation: the same platform ships pluggable optics as a co-equal option, and the issuer states neither which is primary nor any volume split. No optical component supplier is named anywhere in this document. The pluggable alternative is recorded against the graph's existing tech:pluggable_transceiver node, which already carries a competes_with relationship to tech:cpo from prior sources; this document adds Spectrum-6 as a product that ships both.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade the CPO-adoption reading if NVIDIA or its customers later disclose that Spectrum-6 gigascale deployments are predominantly pluggable, or if CPO variants slip out of volume shipment. Strengthen only when a customer-side or third-party source discloses CPO attach rate or names a CPO optical supplier. 核查頻率：每季財報與 OFC/ECOC；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA announced a multiyear technology partnership with SK hynix to advance next-generation memory for the global AI factory buildout. The issuer characterises this as a technology partnership, not an investment and not a supply contract, and discloses no volume, value, exclusivity or duration beyond the word multiyear. SK hynix being named does not establish that any other memory maker was excluded: absence of mention is not evidence of absence.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if either party discloses termination, or if the partnership is later described as carrying exclusivity that would displace other memory suppliers. 核查頻率：每季財報；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA announced strategic partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent compute financing platforms to mobilize over USD 500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout. The issuer explicitly qualifies this as subject to definitive agreements, so it is an announced intent rather than executed financing.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade to speculative if definitive agreements are not disclosed within four quarters, or if the mobilized amount is later restated materially below USD 500 billion. 核查頻率：每季財報；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA names CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius as partners running Vera Rubin racks in full production, and separately states that SpaceXAI will deploy NVIDIA Vera CPUs for agentic AI applications. These are issuer-side statements of deployment; the issuer discloses no volumes, no contract values and no exclusivity for any named partner. Note the wording difference: the five rack partners are described as already running, while SpaceXAI is described in the future tense (will deploy).
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if any named partner discloses that it has paused, cancelled or materially reduced its Vera Rubin deployment, or if NVIDIA stops naming these partners in subsequent quarters. 核查頻率：每季財報；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。
